WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    s.School,
    s.GSserved,
    REPLACE(TRIM(s.GSserved), ' ', '') AS gs
  FROM schools AS s
  WHERE TRIM(s.NCESDist) = '0613360'
    AND s.StatusType = 'Active'
    AND s.School IS NOT NULL
    AND TRIM(s.School) <> ''
    AND s.School <> 'None'
    AND s.GSserved IS NOT NULL
    AND s.GSserved <> 'None'
    AND (
      REPLACE(TRIM(s.GSserved), ' ', '') LIKE '%-12'
      OR REPLACE(TRIM(s.GSserved), ' ', '') = '12'
    )
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM satscores AS sat
      WHERE sat.cds = s.CDSCode
        AND sat.rtype = 'S'
        AND sat.NumTstTakr > 0
    )
), filtered AS (
  SELECT
    School,
    GSserved,
    CASE
      WHEN gs LIKE 'Pre-K%' THEN 'Pre-K'
      WHEN gs LIKE '%-%' THEN TRIM(SUBSTR(gs, 1, INSTR(gs, '-') - 1))
      ELSE gs
    END AS start_grade
  FROM base
), ordered AS (
  SELECT
    School,
    GSserved,
    CASE
      WHEN UPPER(start_grade) IN ('PK','PS','PREK','PRE-K','PRESCHOOL','PRE','P') THEN 0
      WHEN UPPER(start_grade) = 'TK' THEN 0.5
      WHEN UPPER(start_grade) = 'K' THEN 1
      WHEN start_grade GLOB '[0-9]*' THEN CAST(start_grade AS INTEGER) + 1
      ELSE 999
    END AS grade_order
  FROM filtered
)
SELECT
  School,
  GSserved
FROM ordered
WHERE grade_order = (SELECT MIN(grade_order) FROM ordered)
ORDER BY School;	----- bird -----	california_schools

WITH public_districts AS (
    SELECT
        district_prefix,
        County,
        COALESCE(
            MIN(CASE WHEN is_district_row = 1 THEN District END),
            MIN(District)
        ) AS District
    FROM (
        SELECT
            substr(CDSCode, 1, 7) AS district_prefix,
            County,
            NULLIF(District, '') AS District,
            CASE WHEN substr(CDSCode, -7) = '0000000' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_district_row
        FROM schools
        WHERE County IN ('Amador', 'Madera')
          AND (
                DOCType LIKE '%Unified School District%'
             OR DOCType LIKE '%Elementary School District%'
             OR DOCType LIKE '%High School District%'
             OR DOCType LIKE '%County Office%'
          )
    ) AS s
    GROUP BY district_prefix, County
),
school_admins AS (
    SELECT
        CDSCode,
        substr(CDSCode, 1, 7) AS district_prefix,
        County,
        TRIM(AdmFName1) AS fname
    FROM schools
    WHERE County IN ('Amador', 'Madera')
      AND substr(CDSCode, -7) <> '0000000'
      AND substr(CDSCode, 1, 7) IN (SELECT district_prefix FROM public_districts)
      AND AdmFName1 IS NOT NULL
      AND TRIM(AdmFName1) <> ''

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        CDSCode,
        substr(CDSCode, 1, 7),
        County,
        TRIM(AdmFName2)
    FROM schools
    WHERE County IN ('Amador', 'Madera')
      AND substr(CDSCode, -7) <> '0000000'
      AND substr(CDSCode, 1, 7) IN (SELECT district_prefix FROM public_districts)
      AND AdmFName2 IS NOT NULL
      AND TRIM(AdmFName2) <> ''

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        CDSCode,
        substr(CDSCode, 1, 7),
        County,
        TRIM(AdmFName3)
    FROM schools
    WHERE County IN ('Amador', 'Madera')
      AND substr(CDSCode, -7) <> '0000000'
      AND substr(CDSCode, 1, 7) IN (SELECT district_prefix FROM public_districts)
      AND AdmFName3 IS NOT NULL
      AND TRIM(AdmFName3) <> ''
),
top_names AS (
    SELECT fname
    FROM school_admins
    GROUP BY fname
    ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT CDSCode) DESC, fname ASC
    LIMIT 2
),
result AS (
    SELECT
        d.district_prefix,
        d.County,
        d.District,
        t.fname,
        COUNT(DISTINCT sa.CDSCode) AS school_count
    FROM public_districts d
    CROSS JOIN top_names t
    LEFT JOIN school_admins sa
      ON sa.district_prefix = d.district_prefix
     AND sa.County = d.County
     AND sa.fname = t.fname
    GROUP BY d.district_prefix, d.County, d.District, t.fname
)
SELECT District, fname AS first_name, school_count
FROM result
ORDER BY County, District, fname, district_prefix;	----- bird -----	california_schools

WITH categories AS (
  SELECT 'Directly funded' AS FundingType
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Locally funded'
),
active_charters AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CDSCode,
    FundingType
  FROM schools
  WHERE StatusType = 'Active'
    AND Charter = 1
    AND FundingType IN ('Directly funded', 'Locally funded')
),
frpm_2014 AS (
  SELECT
    CDSCode,
    SUM(CAST(NULLIF(NULLIF(`Enrollment (K-12)`, 'None'), '') AS REAL)) AS enrollment_k12,
    AVG(CAST(NULLIF(NULLIF(`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)`, 'None'), '') AS REAL)) AS frpm_pct
  FROM frpm
  WHERE `Academic Year` = '2014-2015'
  GROUP BY CDSCode
),
sat_school AS (
  SELECT
    cds AS CDSCode,
    AVG(
      CAST(NULLIF(NULLIF(AvgScrRead, 'None'), '') AS REAL) +
      CAST(NULLIF(NULLIF(AvgScrMath, 'None'), '') AS REAL) +
      CAST(NULLIF(NULLIF(AvgScrWrite, 'None'), '') AS REAL)
    ) AS combined_sat
  FROM satscores
  WHERE rtype = 'S'
    AND NULLIF(NULLIF(AvgScrRead, 'None'), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(NULLIF(AvgScrMath, 'None'), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(NULLIF(AvgScrWrite, 'None'), '') IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY cds
)
SELECT
  c.FundingType,
  COUNT(DISTINCT ac.CDSCode) AS charter_school_count,
  COALESCE(SUM(f.enrollment_k12), 0) AS total_enrollment_k12,
  ROUND(AVG(f.frpm_pct * 100), 2) AS avg_frpm_eligible_percent,
  ROUND(AVG(s.combined_sat), 2) AS avg_combined_sat_score
FROM categories AS c
LEFT JOIN active_charters AS ac
  ON c.FundingType = ac.FundingType
LEFT JOIN frpm_2014 AS f
  ON ac.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
LEFT JOIN sat_school AS s
  ON ac.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
GROUP BY c.FundingType
ORDER BY c.FundingType;	----- bird -----	california_schools

WITH target_county AS (
    SELECT County
    FROM schools
    WHERE CDSCode = '1612590125716'
    LIMIT 1
),
filtered_schools AS (
    SELECT
        f.CDSCode,
        f.`Charter School (Y/N)` AS charter_indicator,
        ROUND(
            f.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` * 100.0 / NULLIF(f.`Enrollment (K-12)`, 0),
            2
        ) AS free_pct,
        ROUND(
            f.`FRPM Count (K-12)` * 100.0 / NULLIF(f.`Enrollment (K-12)`, 0),
            2
        ) AS frpm_pct,
        CASE
            WHEN s.cds IS NOT NULL
                 AND s.AvgScrRead IS NOT NULL
                 AND s.AvgScrMath IS NOT NULL
                 AND s.AvgScrWrite IS NOT NULL
            THEN s.AvgScrRead + s.AvgScrMath + s.AvgScrWrite
        END AS sat_total
    FROM frpm AS f
    JOIN schools AS sch
        ON f.CDSCode = sch.CDSCode
    JOIN target_county AS tc
        ON sch.County = tc.County
    LEFT JOIN satscores AS s
        ON s.cds = f.CDSCode
       AND s.rtype = 'S'
    WHERE f.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` > 500
      AND f.`FRPM Count (K-12)` < 700
)
SELECT
    (SELECT County FROM target_county) AS county_name,

WITH RECURSIVE base AS (
    SELECT
        c.id,
        c.uuid,
        TRIM(
            REPLACE(
                REPLACE(
                    REPLACE(
                        REPLACE(c.colors, '[', ''),
                        ']', ''
                    ),
                    CHAR(34), ''
                ),
                CHAR(39), ''
            )
        ) AS color_list
    FROM cards AS c
    WHERE c.id BETWEEN 1 AND 20
      AND c.colors IS NOT NULL
),
split AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        uuid,
        CASE
            WHEN INSTR(color_list, ',') > 0
            THEN TRIM(SUBSTR(color_list, 1, INSTR(color_list, ',') - 1))
            ELSE TRIM(color_list)
        END AS color,
        CASE
            WHEN INSTR(color_list, ',') > 0
            THEN SUBSTR(color_list, INSTR(color_list, ',') + 1)
            ELSE NULL
        END AS rest
    FROM base
    WHERE color_list <> ''

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        id,
        uuid,
        CASE
            WHEN INSTR(rest, ',') > 0
            THEN TRIM(SUBSTR(rest, 1, INSTR(rest, ',') - 1))
            ELSE TRIM(rest)
        END,
        CASE
            WHEN INSTR(rest, ',') > 0
            THEN SUBSTR(rest, INSTR(rest, ',') + 1)
            ELSE NULL
        END
    FROM split
    WHERE rest IS NOT NULL
      AND TRIM(rest) <> ''
)

        l.account_id,
        SUM(l.amount) AS loan_amount,
        (
            SELECT l2.status
            FROM loan l2
            WHERE l2.account_id = l.account_id
            ORDER BY l2.date DESC, l2.loan_id DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS loan_status
    FROM loan l
    GROUP BY l.account_id
),
trans_agg AS (
    SELECT
        account_id,
        COUNT(*) AS transaction_count,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total_income,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total_expense
    FROM trans
    GROUP BY account_id
),
district_ranked AS (
    SELECT
        district_id,
        A2,
        A3,
        CAST(A4 AS INTEGER) AS inhabitants,
        A11,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY A3 ORDER BY CAST(A4 AS INTEGER) DESC) AS pop_rank
    FROM district
),
region_top AS (
    SELECT A3, A2, inhabitants
    FROM (
        SELECT
            A3,
            A2,
            inhabitants,
            district_id,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY A3 ORDER BY inhabitants DESC, district_id) AS rn
        FROM district_ranked
    ) AS x
    WHERE rn = 1
),
region_client_count AS (
    SELECT
        d.A3,
        COUNT(c.client_id) AS client_count
    FROM client c
    JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
    GROUP BY d.A3
)
SELECT
    a.account_id,
    a.date AS account_opened_date,
    a.frequency,
    d.A2 AS district_name,
    d.A3 AS region,
    CASE
        WHEN a.district_id = (SELECT district_id FROM client WHERE client_id = 3541) THEN 'Yes'
        ELSE 'No'
    END AS is_client_home_district,
    d.A11 AS average_salary,
    COALESCE(la.loan_status, 'none') AS loan_status,
    COALESCE(la.loan_amount, 0) AS loan_amount,
    COALESCE(ta.transaction_count, 0) AS transaction_count,
    COALESCE(ta.total_income, 0) AS total_income,
    COALESCE(ta.total_expense, 0) AS total_expense,
    COALESCE(ta.total_income, 0) - COALESCE(ta.total_expense, 0) AS net_balance,
    COALESCE(rcc.client_count, 0) AS clients_in_region,
    rt.A2 AS most_populous_district_name,
    rt.inhabitants AS most_populous_district_inhabitants,
    dr.pop_rank AS population_rank
FROM accounts acc
JOIN account a ON acc.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN district_ranked dr ON d.district_id = dr.district_id
LEFT JOIN loan_agg la ON a.account_id = la.account_id
LEFT JOIN trans_agg ta ON a.account_id = ta.account_id
LEFT JOIN region_client_count rcc ON d.A3 = rcc.A3
LEFT JOIN region_top rt ON d.A3 = rt.A3
ORDER BY transaction_count DESC, a.account_id ASC;	----- bird -----	financial

    COUNT(b.bond_id) AS bond_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN b.bond_type IN ('=', '#') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS multiple_bond_count
  FROM molecule AS m
  LEFT JOIN bond AS b
    ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
  GROUP BY
    m.molecule_id
),
carbon_touching_bonds AS (
  SELECT
    b.molecule_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_id) AS carbon_touching_bond_count
  FROM bond AS b
  JOIN connected AS c
    ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
  JOIN atom AS a1
    ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
  JOIN atom AS a2
    ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
  WHERE LOWER(a1.element) = 'c'
     OR LOWER(a2.element) = 'c'
  GROUP BY
    b.molecule_id

      COALESCE(ctb.carbon_touching_bond_count, 0) DESC,
      COALESCE(ast.atom_count, 0) DESC,
      ast.molecule_id ASC

  ast.label,
  COALESCE(ast.atom_count, 0) AS atom_count,
  COALESCE(bs.bond_count, 0) AS bond_count,

  COALESCE(ast.chlorine_atom_count, 0) AS chlorine_atom_count,
  COALESCE(ctb.carbon_touching_bond_count, 0) AS carbon_touching_bond_count,
  COALESCE(bs.multiple_bond_count, 0) AS multiple_bond_count
